safety.q: What makes Draft safer than ChatGPT?
safety.a: Draft is specifically designed for education with hallucination-safe AI that won't generate false information. Unlike ChatGPT, it's trained on educational contexts and includes safety guardrails to ensure accurate, appropriate content for school communications.

cancel.a: Yes, absolutely. You can cancel your subscription at any time with no penalties or fees. Your access will continue until the end of your current billing period, and you can always restart later.

refunds.a: We offer a 30-day money-back guarantee. If you're not satisfied with Draft for any reason within your first 30 days, contact us for a full refund.

privacy.a: Yes, your data is completely private and secure. We're GDPR compliant, never train AI models on your content, and all data is encrypted. Your student information and communications remain confidential at all times.

bundle.a: The bundle includes full access to both Draft (unlimited comments, translations, priority support) and Zaza Teach (lesson planning, resource library, curriculum alignment tools) at a discounted rate.

changePlans.q: Can I upgrade or downgrade plans?
changePlans.a: Yes, you can change your plan at any time from your account settings. Upgrades take effect immediately, while downgrades take effect at your next billing cycle.
